question: Is there any means to liberation other than the one taught here?
premises: A means to liberation has been indicated.
No other means to liberation exists apart from it.
In some cases the result comes effortlessly and through the sequence of living liberation.
inference: There is no alternative means to liberation, though its realization may vary in ease and in following the path of living liberation.
uncertainties: The antecedent of etad is not explicit in this verse and depends on the immediate context.
plain_english: There is no means to liberation whatsoever other than this; only, in some cases, it comes effortlessly and through the sequence of liberation while still living.
